subject: config.c: Avoid leaking file handle if redis_fstat() fails (#12796)
reason: The change only adds fclose(fp) on an error path in rewriteConfigReadOldFile() that is taken when redis_fstat() fails on a file descriptor that was just successfully opened via fopen(). That failure cannot be provoked without syscall-level fault injection, which the fuzzer does not have: CONFIG REWRITE succeeds identically on both builds and the function's return value and all observable behaviour are unchanged on every reachable path. The fix is a pure resource-leak cleanup on an unreachable-in-practice branch, so no scenario can exercise the changed code.
